lines.cap: Trees are secretly hooking up, underground.
lines.say: Trees are secretly hooking up, underground.

lines.cap: A forest looks like a crowd of separate trees, all fighting for light.
lines.say: A forest looks like a crowd of separate trees, all fighting for light.

lines.cap: But dig down, and the roots are wrapped in fungus. Threads thinner than a hair.
lines.say: But dig down, and the roots are wrapped in fungus. Threads thinner than a hair.

lines.cap: Those threads spread through the soil, and can link one tree to another. Scientists call it the wood wide web.
lines.say: Those threads spread through the soil, and can link one tree to another. Scientists call it the wood wide web.

lines.cap: The deal: trees give the fungus sugar. The fungus brings back water and nutrients.
lines.say: The deal: trees give the fungus sugar. The fungus brings back water and nutrients.

lines.cap: Experiments found carbon moving between trees through the network, even between different species.
lines.say: Experiments found carbon moving between trees through the network, even between different species.

lines.cap: How much trees really help each other this way is still hotly debated by scientists.
lines.say: How much trees really help each other this way is still hotly debated by scientists.

lines.cap: But one thing is certain. Under every forest, there's a lot of hooking up going on.
